source: independent (non-author) general-purpose agent reviewing data/aggregates/build-reasoning.json + hero-coach-lines.json + the coach report against their own source blocks; suggested rewrites ground-checked by copy-verify, then applied back

support.quote: Into Riktor, Dekker or Muriel, a missed Imperial Lash leaves you stranded; wait for their hook or stun first, then lash.
support.issue: a missed Imperial Lash means no dash, so it does not strand you; the logic is backwards
support.rewrite: Into Riktor, Dekker or Muriel, wait for their hook or stun first, then Imperial Lash, since a hit dashes you onto them.

jungle.quote: Gank over walls with Glacial Charge, land Hoarfrost on the laner, then Boreal Sweep while they are rooted. Later, Cryoseism a grouped fight and jump between targets so your Replica soaks damage.
jungle.issue: Replica only draws tower aggro per SOURCE; 'soaks damage' from heroes overstates it
jungle.rewrite: Gank with Glacial Charge, land Hoarfrost on the laner, then Boreal Sweep while they are rooted. Later, Cryoseism a grouped fight and jump to reposition, leaving your Replica behind.

support.quote: A fence dropped behind your carry traps your own team; place Containment Fence between the divers and your carry, never on top of them.
support.issue: Containment Fence only blocks Enemy Heroes; it cannot trap your own team
support.rewrite: Containment Fence only blocks enemy heroes, so place it between the divers and your carry to keep them off.

offlane.quote: Leap in with Assault The Gates, Make Way under them to shred armor, then the empowered Sacred Oath basic for the cleave. Once your damage items land, landing Assault The Gates on a hero cuts its cooldown for a second leap.
offlane.issue: the 30% cooldown cut is not tied to items and is not an instant second leap
offlane.rewrite: Leap in with Assault The Gates, Make Way under them to shred armor, then the empowered Sacred Oath basic for the cleave. Hitting a hero with Assault The Gates cuts its cooldown by 30%, so you leap again sooner.

jungle.quote: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, Surge of the Heavens back to the blade for the knock-up, then Light of the Heavens for true damage. Later, Fury of the Heavens teleports to your blade, so throw it behind their carry first.
jungle.issue: after Surge of the Heavens recalls the blade, Light of the Heavens deals magical damage with a shield; true damage needs the blade in the world
jungle.rewrite: Throw Judgement of the Heavens to tether them, cast Light of the Heavens while the blade is still out for true damage, then Surge of the Heavens back to it for the knock-up. Later, Fury of the Heavens teleports to your blade, so throw it behind their carry first.

midlane.quote: Throw Data Burst to slow, send L.I.N.X through the target and back, then dash with Erase Vector for the exploding Jolt. Every third ability is Overclocked, so save that for Data Burst's mesmerize, and use Final Thread to finish low targets.
midlane.issue: Overclock triggers on the ability after 3 Threads (the fourth), not every third ability
midlane.rewrite: Throw Data Burst to slow, send L.I.N.X through the target and back, then dash with Erase Vector for the exploding Jolt. Three abilities make your next one Overclocked, so save it for Data Burst's mesmerize, and use Final Thread to finish low targets.

midlane.quote: The field has lost with the Combustion opener, and Lt. Belica, Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; farm safely when behind.
midlane.issue: leads with a build-stat caveat instead of a lane action
midlane.rewrite: Lt. Belica, Gideon and Gadget beat you in lane; farm safely when behind and only trade when your abilities are ready.

carry.quote: The field has lost with the Deathstalker opener, and TwinBlast, Sparrow, Murdock and Kira beat you in lane; poke from range.
carry.issue: leads with a build-stat caveat instead of a lane action
carry.rewrite: TwinBlast, Sparrow, Murdock and Kira beat you in lane; poke from range with Knock, Knock! instead of trading up close.
